events.title: Ancient and Modern: A woven dialogue
events.summary: Free exhibition of weaving by Sharon Kearley and Ali Holloway. Open Tuesday–Saturday 11am–6pm and Sunday 11.30am–5.30pm. Both artists attend on 5 and 12 September; further individual dates are listed by the organiser.

events.title: Birds of the Heath in the Autumn
events.summary: Pete Mantle leads the autumn bird walk from Burgh House at 9am. Bring binoculars and sturdy footwear. The Society's guided-walk programme requires no advance booking and asks for a minimum £5 donation per adult.

events.title: Drop-In Gardening at the Hive
events.summary: Drop-in gardening and light conservation from 4pm to 5pm around the Hive. No booking is required; equipment, tea and biscuits are provided. See the organiser's listing for arrangements for children.

events.title: Charing Cross and Waterloo East station closure
events.location: London Charing Cross and London Waterloo East
events.summary: No trains serve either station during a 22-day, £20m engineering programme. Southeastern routes divert to other London terminals and weekend arrangements can vary.

events.title: Tower of London Opening Ceremony Experience
events.summary: A maximum of 50 visitors per day can watch the Tower open before regular admission and then enter the Crown Jewels first. Arrive at the Middle Drawbridge by 8.30am.

events.title: Play Make Do family festival
events.summary: The family festival combines circus, dance, storytelling, craft and quieter creative spaces, with free and affordable activities across the Barbican.

events.title: Metropolitan Brass Band at Golders Hill Park
events.summary: A free, no-booking summer concert runs from 3pm to 5pm at the Golders Hill Park bandstand.

events.title: Flow and Write at Keats House
events.summary: An adult yoga and creative-writing workshop runs from 10.45am to 12.45pm. Tickets are £18, house admission is included and no previous experience is required.

events.title: AI Filmmaking Summer Intensive
events.summary: A five-day, £1,200 intensive takes teams from concept to a completed AI-assisted short film while covering copyright, likeness, consent and transparency.

events.title: Neuroinformatics Open Software Summer School
events.summary: Selected researchers, developers and users convene for two weeks of open-source neuroscience training, community building and hacking.

events.title: Outdoor cinema: Arrival
events.summary: The captioned and audio-described open-air screening starts at 8.30pm. Standard tickets are £20 before the booking fee and headphones are supplied.

events.title: Barbican Conservatory Plant Adoption
events.summary: The first free adoption session runs from noon to 5pm, pairing a Conservatory visit with one of more than 2,000 propagated plant cuttings. Donations support restoration.

events.title: City Plan 2040 additional statements deadline
events.summary: Additional hearing statements on the tall-building contours and Tower of London World Heritage Site issue are due by 5pm.

events.title: Charing Cross and Waterloo East follow-up closure
events.location: London Charing Cross and London Waterloo East
events.summary: Neither station will be served during a follow-up engineering weekend; Network Rail says the alternative service plan may differ from the main closure.

events.title: Gladiators to Centurions walking tour
events.venue: Guildhall Art Gallery and Roman Amphitheatre
events.summary: A 90-minute expert walk starts at the Roman Amphitheatre and finishes at the rarely accessible Roman Fort Gate; the route includes uneven surfaces and steps.

events.title: Othello at Kenwood
events.summary: The Lord Chamberlain’s Men stage an outdoor Othello from 7pm to 9.45pm; doors open at 6pm and audiences should bring a chair and picnic.

events.title: Mad Dog Bites at Parliament Hill Bandstand
events.summary: A free, no-booking rock concert runs from 3pm to 5pm at Parliament Hill Bandstand.

events.title: Hampstead Heath photo competition deadline
events.summary: Free entries close at midnight for the 2027 Hampstead Heath calendar. Entrants may submit up to three landscape-format photographs taken on the Heath.

events.title: UCL Hatchery incubator application deadline
events.summary: Applications close at 11.59pm for UCL's two-year, equity-free incubator. Applicants must be current UCL students or recent graduates and have a registered company.

events.title: City Plan 2040 additional hearings
events.summary: Additional public examination sessions consider the tall-building contours around the Tower of London World Heritage Site.

events.title: London 6G Week
events.summary: London 6G Week at King’s College London, 7–11 September. IEEE CSCN runs 7–9 September; one6G Summit runs 10–11 September. Summit registration remains open: €390 general admission including VAT; €150 for verified members with code; verified enrolled students free. CSCN registration is separate.

events.title: Open House Festival
events.summary: London's free architecture festival returns across all 33 boroughs. Bookings for ticketed activities open at noon on Wednesday 19 August.

events.title: Barbican Conservatory Plant Adoption
events.summary: A further free plant-adoption event is planned before the Conservatory's major restoration closure; booking details are published by the Barbican.

events.title: Gladiators to Centurions walking tour
events.venue: Guildhall Art Gallery and Roman Amphitheatre
events.summary: A second 90-minute expert walk starts at the Roman Amphitheatre and finishes at the rarely accessible Roman Fort Gate; the route includes uneven surfaces and steps.

events.title: Barbican Conservatory Plant Adoption
events.summary: The third announced free plant-adoption event offers propagated cuttings before the Conservatory's restoration closure; booking details are published by the Barbican.

events.title: Kimberly Akimbo
events.summary: European premiere starring Maria Friedman. Limited seats listed for 5 September at 7.30pm. Preview full-price bands £40–£90; later full-price bands £45–£110, subject to change. Age guidance 14+. Select a performance and check remaining seats.

events.title: The Nightingale Suite exhibition talk
events.summary: Martin Huxter discusses artwork inspired by nightingale song, 2.15–3.15pm. £10 including museum entry; tickets available when checked on 5 September.

events.title: Horizon 22 early-bird visit
events.summary: £15 early access with audio-visual guide and a refreshment. 8am and 8.15am slots available when checked; tickets non-refundable and non-transferable. Views depend on weather.

events.title: Holy Sepulchre Open House afternoon
events.summary: Free drop-in opening noon–4pm, including the church and emerging plans. History talk 1–1.45pm. A separate 2pm walking tour requires festival-account booking.
